page.overview:
What is Lonely Freddy?

is a brand of animatronic toys manufactured by Fazbear Entertainment. One of these serves as a main antagonist from Fazbear Frights 2: Fetch's second story of the same name. They are animatronic-like toy versions of Freddy Fazbear.

In the story, they're described as smaller versions of Freddy Fazbear. They're two feet tall with glowing deep blue eyes, soft plush paws, and unhinged, stuffed mouths. When idle, they stand in a stock-straight posture with a dead stare. The main Lonely Freddy, that is inhabited by Alec's consciousness after body-swapping with him, has light green eyes and is vomited on.

In the unused illustration they look similar to their description in the book. They also have freckles on their snouts, little speakers on their chests, and upper teeth.

The Lonely Freddies are intended to play with children at parties who have no one else to play with. The main Lonely Freddy in the story, however, has the ability to paralyze, interrogate, and eventually swap bodies with another person. It's speculated that Lonely Freddy was created and controlled by William Afton to steal children's souls like the Funtime Animatronics. It is unknown whether all Lonely Freddies were built for this purpose, or William has tampered with this single toy.
